newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia March merchandise imports A$5.991 bln.
newsitem.headline: Australia March merchandise imports A$5.991 bln.

text.p: Australia's international merchandise imports stood at A$5.991 billion in March from a reported A$6.098 billion in February, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.

This measure is compiled from information submitted by importers or their agents to the Australian customs service. It is not seasonally adjusted nor is it reported on the same balance of payments basis as monthly current account data.
This new measure takes the place of former merchandise imports figures which are now included in a monthly merchandise trade balance series.
